answer.reason: The verses tell what was given to him and what he made for the tabernacle, beyond the summary's calling and descent.

clauses.english: was filled with the spirit of God in wisdom and all manner of workmanship
clauses.quote: I have filled him with the spirit of God

clauses.english: made the ark of shittim wood
clauses.quote: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood

clauses.english: made all that the LORD commanded Moses
clauses.quote: made all that the LORD commanded Moses

doubts: EXO 34:23 and NUM 16:9 are marked but do not concern this person; left out.
EXO 36:8 and EXO 38:19 are marked but speak of other workmen or of pillars, not of him by name; left out.
The brazen altar he made (2CH 1:5) is left out as part of all he made.
